name: New York Public Library, Stephen A. Schwarzman Building
aka: New York Public Library Main Branch

dates.altered: The Rose Main Reading Room and Public Catalog Room were separately designated a New York City interior landmark in 2017 after their ceiling was repaired; the Midtown Campus renovation is current work.
dates.note: The style node's exemplar gives 1911 and its note '1897-1911'. Wikipedia gives 'Built 1897-1911' and an opening to the public of May 23, 1911. No disagreement.

refs.title: New York Public Library Main Branch - Wikipedia
refs.note: Gives the address as 476 Fifth Avenue, the architects as Carrere and Hastings, the style as 'Beaux-Arts', and the four separate landmark designations.

refs.title: National Historic Landmark designated December 21, 1965, reference no. 66000546; listed on the National Register October 15, 1966 under the same number, as the Wikipedia infobox prints it
refs.note: Read from the infobox, not from the National Register's own database. The landmark designation precedes the Register listing by ten months, which is why one number carries two dates.

refs.title: New York State Register of Historic Places, designated June 23, 1980, reference no. 06101.000079
Stephen A. Schwarzman Building - Mecanoo
refs.note: The architects of the current Midtown Campus renovation; cited for the building's present name and status, not for its history.

note: Written for WP-11.2 Tranche 2. The building the style node names for the Ecole plan method applied to a public programme; no HABS survey was found for it, which is normal for a building that has never been threatened.
